fusions.name: Dragged Under
fusions.desc: Clamps the lash on an enemy at or below 30% health within 3.5 tiles and rolls, which deals 24 damage, lowers its armour by 20% for 5 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that clamps and rolls, which deals 15 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snare in the Reeds
fusions.desc: Sets a coiled snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 1 minute; the first enemy to come within 2 tiles springs it, which deals 20 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Still Until the Snap
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
